name: Bay Street Theater & Sag Harbor Center for the Arts

evidence.note: Theater describes itself as a 299-seat professional regional theater on Long Wharf.
Reviews describe a cozy little theater with good seats; none mention dancing.
Venue page for The Chain (Fleetwood Mac tribute) on Oct 3 at 8 PM; the band bio says fans like to sing along and dance.

dancing.notes: This is a seated theater with rows of seats and no dance floor. Plan on a sit-down concert.

description: A nonprofit professional theater with about 300 seats on Long Wharf at the foot of Main Street in Sag Harbor. It puts on plays, comedy and live music concerts.
factsSource: Checked October 4, 2026. Sources: baystreet.org, facebook.com, pictame.com.
reviewNotes:
Added from Ira's List research (2026-10-03).

Directory research 2026-10-04: The theater site does not link any social pages that we could find. Facebook (facebook.com/baysttheater) is kept from our current data, not re-verified on Facebook. Instagram @baystreettheater found by search (name and location match, about 8.5K followers) but not linked from the site; owner may want to confirm. Photo file names suggest photographers (Harun Zankel for the banners photo; 'Heller' for the band photo); credits could add their names. An audience photo was skipped because it shows many faces and may include minors. Admin office phone is (631) 725-0818 (not recorded). Existing description still fits; it is a seated theater, so no dance floor.
hours: Box office Wed-Sat 12 PM-5 PM and 30 minutes before showtime

logo.alt: Bay Street Theater logo: the words Bay Street Theater in tall white serif letters on a black square

A band plays guitars on the Bay Street Theater stage in front of a British flag backdrop while a full house watches

evidence.note: Theater site: not-for-profit 299-seat professional theater; box office at 1 Long Wharf, Sag Harbor, NY 11963, (631) 725-9500, boxoffice@baystreet.org; at the corner of Main and Bay Streets; paid parking on Long Wharf.
Home page footer: box office hours noon-5 PM Wednesday-Saturday or 30 minutes before showtime; season includes live music tribute concerts, comedy and plays.
About page: year-round not-for-profit theater and community cultural center since 1991; the home photo caption is the 2015 'Beatles vs. the Rolling Stones' battle of the bands.
